rq2.clock: V6 nominal10Hz; not uniform physical seconds
rq2.recurrent: none in frozen base (RiskProp V6 fc per snippet); adapters only
rq2.activation_checkpoint: residual blocks, nonreentrant, BN buffers restored on recompute

Combined.mTTA_reason: Computed from full curves below; author-index10/inferred-anchor convention, not verified Table1 equivalence.

Public.mTTA_reason: Computed from full curves below; author-index10/inferred-anchor convention, not verified Table1 equivalence.

Private.mTTA_reason: Computed from full curves below; author-index10/inferred-anchor convention, not verified Table1 equivalence.

temporal_metrics.threshold_selection: test-negative-frame empirical ranks, unchanged source descriptive evaluation; not deployment calibration
temporal_metrics.clock: source snippet-index difference / 10, NOT guaranteed physical seconds

data_manifest.decode: OpenCV native-frame decode + default JPEG encode/decode on demand; avoids full JPG materialization
data_manifest.sampling_clock: reported source: fps=30 in loader, stride=3 original frame indices; not uniform physical 10 Hz for non-30-FPS videos
data_manifest.timestamp_mapping: reported: original author CSV, int(timestamp * native video FPS), zero-based

cache_header.representation: FP32 packed [55,2048,T+1,1,1]; final column exact original spatial/temporal mean
cache_header.sampling: source train pipeline once per video, stable per-video CPU RNG; source validation pipeline

hyperparameters.rationale: Winner of the v1.1 H7 study for all three modules; reused unchanged, no new tuning.

training_contract.scientific_scope: exploratory cached-feature study; separate from online fresh-augmentation RQ3

spec.baseline_input: Approved selected H7 weights plus original sealed metadata; not H7 resume
spec.guardrail: delta mAP >= -0.01; report paired interval, do not infer from means alone
spec.motion: mean(phi(projected difference)-phi(0)); nonlinear before pooling; no physical-speed claim
spec.precision: FP32 train/val/test, autocast and TF32 disabled
spec.residual_gate: input-conditioned sigmoid, bias=-2 (nonzero gate output); correction=C*g*tanh(raw)
spec.residual_initialization: output weight and bias zero; no second zero multiplicative gate
spec.temporal_features: spatial mean only; actual encoder T retained
spec.test_gate: all declared arms x all three seeds complete before any final test scoring
spec.training_augmentation: inherited RQ2 RandomResizedCrop/Flip; not static .npy training
spec.window_policy: independent reset, shared weights, oldest-to-newest, includes current token

training_contract.training_views: one fixed sampled/augmented train view per video; validation deterministic

notes: Pooled1344 curve-level evaluation, NOT averaging Public/Private metrics.
mAP/AUC are macro means across original lead cohorts, as in RQ1.
mTTA source arithmetic unchanged; index-clock/anchors inferred, not Table1 parity.
Test-negative empirical ranks describe ROC performance, not calibrated deployment alarms.
All positive misses remain zero in the denominator; no prediction-tail extrapolation.
